headline: Software Engineer | Full-Stack, Frontend, Backend & AI Development
summary: Versatile Software Engineer with experience spanning full-stack web applications, backend distributed systems, and modern AI-driven solutions. Proven expertise building responsive user interfaces in React and Next.js at Tomorrow's Leaders Today, developing robust services in Java and Python, and integrating cutting-edge AI technologies (Anthropic Claude API, MCP, Google AI, scikit-learn). Passionate about shipping performant, accessible, and intelligent software across the entire stack.

employment.title: Web Developer
bullets: Shaped user experience and information architecture for the web platform, reworking navigation and page structure, mapping user journeys, and sharpening calls-to-action to make the site more intuitive to use, as part of a hands-on, project-based leadership program.

Also pitched in on the front-end/responsive-design, QA/performance, and AI-workflow/documentation teams as needed, helping with responsive layout fixes, accessibility and cross-browser testing, and documentation for TLT's AI-assisted workflows.

education.institution: The University of Texas at Dallas

projects.name: Return-Fraud & Wardrobing Detection Pipeline
projects.description: Graph-based fraud-detection pipeline that catches coordinated return-fraud rings.
bullets: Engineered a scalable, graph-based fraud-detection pipeline (Python, NetworkX, scikit-learn, Neo4j) that models customers, addresses, payment fingerprints, and items as a connected graph to catch coordinated fraud rings that evade standard per-transaction rule thresholds.
Designed a two-layer risk-scoring architecture, with Louvain community detection surfacing structurally linked account clusters, fused with an unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly score.

Shipped a Flask + pyvis review dashboard that outperformed a rule-based baseline on precision and recall while keeping raw PII out of the system via SHA-256-hashed addresses and minimized payment data.

projects.name: Blackboard Student Assistant
projects.description: Manifest V3 Chrome extension for UT Dallas's Blackboard Learn (Ultra and Classic).
bullets: Built a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that performs live DOM scraping to surface grades, GPA impact, and assignment deadlines without requiring API credentials.
Developed a grade calculator engine that computes the minimum score needed on remaining assignments to hit a user-defined target grade.
Integrated Google Calendar OAuth 2.0 to auto-sync deadlines as reminders.
Built a local PDF/DOCX syllabus parser (pdf.js, mammoth.js) requiring zero manual input.

projects.name: Rate Limiter Library
projects.description: Python library implementing four rate-limiting algorithms behind one common interface.
bullets: Implemented four production-grade rate-limiting algorithms (Fixed Window, Sliding Window Log, Sliding Window Counter, Token Bucket) behind one common interface, driven entirely by caller-supplied timestamps for full determinism and reproducible unit testing.
Built steady, bursty, and adversarial traffic generators plus a matplotlib benchmarking harness measuring correctness and peak memory.
Showed Fixed Window leaks up to 2.00x its limit under adversarial traffic, while Sliding Window Counter matched Sliding Window Log's accuracy at a fraction of the memory cost.
